Old Cape Henry Lighthouse
navaid.description: On August 7,1789, by an Act of Congress, the Lighthouse Service was established. Cape Henry, Va. became the site, not only for the government's first light tower, but was its first public works project as well.

features.name: U.S. Coast Guard - Station Cape Charles

navaid.name: U.S. Coast Guard - Station Cape Charles
navaid.description: U.S. Coast Guard Station missions include Search and Rescue, Maritime Law Enforcement, Homeland Security, Ice Rescue, Recreational Boating Safety, Military Readiness, and Environmental Response.

features.name: U.S. Coast Guard - Station Little Creek

navaid.name: U.S. Coast Guard - Station Little Creek
navaid.description: Coast Guard Station Little Creek was rebuilt and renamed in 1995. The station, which replaced the old Cape Henry Station, has a 24-hr communications center, a full-service kitchen, an exercise facility, and sleeping berths for several Coast Guard members.
